FEVer Dreams (Fallout 4 Creation) - Official Trailer
Check out the trailer for FEVer Dreams, a free escape room-style dungeon mod for Fallout 4 from Kinggath Creations. FEVer Dreams is an escape room-style dungeon that "inundates players with hallucinations and flashbacks, including conversations with their spouse.” FEVer Dreams features the returning voices of Courtenay Taylor (who played the female sole Survivor in Fallout 4) and Brian T. Delaney (who played the male Sole Survivor in Fallout 4). FEVer Dreams is available today, October 20, for Fallout 4.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Xbox Staffer Claims Games Industry Is "Pretending to Not Use A.I." - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Xbox Business Strategist Brandon Stirrup caused a firestorm on Twitter recently, admitting that he used AI to create a "little bad game" all on his own. This was to prove his point that AI tools are more widely used in the video game industry than it lets on, considering how anti-AI the gaming public tends to be. Stirrup's hope is that the industry will get over the stigma of AI and just admit that it's now part of the development workflow. Of course, comments weren't necessarily kind to him, and he deleted his Twitter account shortly after, but not before the internet screengrabbed his tweets and plastered them all over Reddit. But he's not necessarily wrong—Unreal Engine has AI tools built in, and Epic Games is coding their new Star Wars shooter solely with AI. Speaking of Star Wars, Lucasfilm is rumored to be approaching several studios to work on Battlefront 3, with DICE, Respawn, and Bungie being the supposed frontrunners. And we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

text:
Dune: Part Three - Official 'Tickets on Sale Now' Trailer
Check out the 'Tickets on Sale' Trailer for Dune: Part Three, the latest addition in the sci-fi film series distributed by Warner Bros. Witness the fallout of the reign of Emperor Paul Atreides in Dune: Part Three, in theaters on December 18.

Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach De Bankolé, with Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Javier Bardem, and features newcomers Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach De Bankolé, with Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Javier Bardem, and features newcomers Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke. Dune: Part Three is directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert, and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

Dune: Part Three opens in theaters on December 18, 2026.
